# The Vault SA

> Car paint protection and detailing studio in Germiston and Bedfordview, Gauteng, South Africa: clear, matte and colour paint protection film (PPF), fitting of wings, spoilers and upgraded body parts, exterior and interior detailing with clay bar decontamination, paint correction and polishing, ceramic coating, and headlight and tail light restoration. By appointment only.

Website: https://thevaultppf.co.za/

## Prices (South African rand, starting prices)
- Frontal PPF: from R15 000, with a complimentary detail. Covers the complete front bumper (painted sections included), the entire bonnet, both front fenders and both painted side-mirror caps
- Full PPF: from R35 000, with a complimentary detail
- Matte PPF: the same price as clear PPF
- Colour PPF: from R40 000, with a complimentary detail, door shuts included (394 TPU colour films to choose from)
- PPF comes with a 5-year warranty
- Large SUVs can cost up to R3 000 extra for clear PPF and up to R5 000 extra for colour PPF
- Wings, spoilers and other body parts: quoted for the parts and the car
- Detail without a wrap: R4 000 to R6 000, depending on the car; interior or exterior details on their own are quoted per car
- Engine bay detailing: an add-on, after an inspection
- Headlight and tail light restoration: from R2 000, depending on how far the damage has gone
- Polishing: basic gloss polish from R1 200, light correction from R2 000, medium correction from R3 500; heavy correction needs an inspection first
- Ceramic coating packages (how long they last assumes appropriate care):
  - Essential Gloss: R2 500 to R3 500, lasts 6 to 12 months. Exterior wash and decontamination, clay bar treatment, light paint enhancement, entry-level ceramic coating or ceramic sealant
  - Signature Ceramic: R4 500 to R6 000, lasts up to 2 years. Full exterior decontamination, clay bar treatment, single-stage machine polish, 2-year-rated ceramic coating, exterior trim protection, complimentary interior clean
  - Premium Ceramic: R6 500 to R8 500, lasts 3 to 5 years. Full exterior decontamination, clay bar treatment, two-stage paint correction, premium multi-year ceramic coating, exterior plastic trim protection, complimentary full detail
- Ceramic coating can go over gloss PPF; over matte PPF it takes away the matte effect
- Not VAT registered, so no VAT is added to these prices
- Every car is inspected before booking, for a professional recommendation

## How long
- Clear PPF, colour PPF and a full detail: about 4 to 5 working days, confirmed at the inspection
- Ceramic coating: 1 to 3 days for the coating itself
- Colour PPF that has to be ordered in: allow 2 to 3 weeks for the film to arrive

## Products
- Detailing: mainly Detail Ease; alternatives such as Meguiar's, depending on what the car needs
- Ceramic coating: Detail Ease or Meguiar's
